title: Icaro Workflow v1
description: A workflow orchestrates sessions (ADR 0002). It is not general-purpose CI. Data flow between steps is part of the contract: steps expose `outputs`, later steps reference them via ${{ steps.<id>.outputs.<key> }} interpolation.

env.description: Workflow-level environment, available to every step and to interpolation as ${{ env.<key> }}. Values may reference secrets via ${{ secrets.<key> }}; secrets are resolved by the credential broker and never inlined.

triggers.description: Single source of truth for what starts a workflow. There is no separate top-level `schedule`; a cron trigger carries its own expression.

cron.description: Required when type=cron; a standard cron expression.

event.description: For github/gitlab/webhook: the event name to match.

repositoryRef.description: A repository resolved once per (ref, revision) for the run.

revision.description: Branch, tag, or commit. Defaults to the repo's default branch when omitted.

step.description: A step runs a container image. There are no built-in step kinds: an agent, a shell command, a JS runtime, or a notification are all just different images. Conditional execution is expressed with `when` rather than a dedicated step type.

image.description: Container image reference to run for this step (e.g. ghcr.io/icaro-dev/agent-base:<version> for an agent, or any image for shell/js/notify work). The single execution primitive.

command.description: Command run inside the image. For an agent image this is the agent CLI invocation; for a notify image it renders/sends a templated message.

env.description: Step-level environment, merged over workflow env. Supports interpolation.

input.description: Inputs to the step. Values may use ${{ steps.<id>.outputs.<key> }}, ${{ env.<key> }}, and ${{ secrets.<key> }} interpolation.

outputs.description: Named outputs this step produces, consumable by dependent steps. Keys are output names; values describe how each is captured (e.g. from stdout, a file, or a JSON path).

when.description: Optional gating on any step: a boolean expression over interpolated values that must hold for the step to run. This replaces a dedicated condition step type. The expression grammar is defined separately and validated semantically.
